ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) background with isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters occupying approximately less than 3% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across both lobes with discrete, high-contrast white circular spots mapped to the central-left region and a higher density of such spots distributed across the mid-to-outer right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central notch with high-depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with the most jagged contours observed on the inner-half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave upward curve originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct detection of circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) located in the central-medial area and scattered throughout the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned horizontal linear pixel disruptions observed on the inner-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white-intensity pixel clusters on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes indicating barnacle colonization; multiple circular scars indicating previous parasitic or epibiotic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique constellation of approximately five prominent circular white rings on the right lobe surface.
